title: We receive Moses as prophet of figures; the Jew denies the prophet of the letter
english: We who are of the church receive Moses as a prophet writing future things in figures. The Jew denies that he is the prophet of the letter.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen opens the homily by contrasting the Church's reception of Moses as a prophet writing future things in figures with the Jew's denial of the prophet of the letter.

title: Fasting from vices on the day of propitiation
english: "You shall afflict your souls; it is a sabbath of sabbaths" (Leviticus 16:31). A fast from vices. The day of propitiation.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is explaining the spiritual meaning of the Day of Atonement commands from Leviticus, applying them to the Christian soul's fasting from sin.

title: The scapegoat carries sins into the desert; Christ bore sins in his body
english: The goat carries their iniquities into the desert. Christ bore our sins in his own body. Amen.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is explaining the Day of Propitiation rite in Leviticus 16, where the goat sent into the desert carries away the people's iniquities, and he applies it to Christ.
